summary: Suppress near-duplicate active alerts during POST create when the same title and severity already exist within a configurable recent window.
constraints: Keep the change inside the existing alert controller -> service -> repository -> EF Core slice.
Duplicate suppression applies only on POST create; existing update/deactivate/delete behavior remains unchanged.
A duplicate must match on title case-insensitively, severity exactly, IsActive == true, and CreatedDate within the configured window.
Suppressed creates return 200 OK with the existing alert and response header X-Duplicate-Suppressed: true.
Genuinely new alerts continue to return 201 Created.
The suppression window must come from appsettings-backed configuration and not be hardcoded in service or repository code.
Reuse TimeProvider for current UTC time evaluation so service tests remain deterministic.
No schema or migration change is expected for this story.
coverage_goals: Controller coverage for 200 suppressed responses, created responses, and X-Duplicate-Suppressed header behavior.
Service coverage for configurable-window evaluation, suppress-versus-create branching, and exclusion of inactive or different-severity alerts.
Repository coverage for recent active duplicate lookup using case-insensitive title matching and time-window filtering.
implementation_assumptions: Duplicate comparison uses the already-trimmed title representation produced by the existing create mapping path.
The recent-window boundary is inclusive for alerts created at or after utcNow minus the configured minutes.
Configuration access should stay minimal and repo-aligned; introduce extra options wiring only if required by the chosen implementation shape.
